reason: This done=true verdict does not cover a safety-order hole: scratch coverage probes re-execute candidate stages after correctness() has finished its safety check and after benchmark() has collected guard_violations(). A store into the first tail-guard byte that happens only when the residual probe poison word is visible was reported ok on both paths. Do not reuse it.
